newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks firm in quiet trading, drinks frothy.
newsitem.headline: French stocks firm in quiet trading, drinks frothy.

text.p: French shares were up more than one percent at midday in thin volume as investors stayed cautious.

Traders said new opinion polls showing a recovery in the conservative majority gave some comfort in the parliamentary election, with one analyst pointing to a widening split between Socialists and Communists after an initial honeymoon period.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 33.52 points or 1.27 percent at 2,667.43 at 1020 GMT, while the CAC-40 futures contract was up 39 at 2,654 from Friday's close.
* LVMH sparkles, up 2.98 percent at 1,419, on Guinness/Grand Met merger, despite chairman Bernard Arnault's resistance to the move which brings conflicts into the champagne and cognacs lines.
* Pernod Ricard rises 3.33 percent to 309.9 as the sector gets a lift.
